open_questions: Confirm-horizon defect ownership: shipped CadenceLegacy (spec-conformant K_c×EAI) is measured to NEVER confirm at 200 ms RTT / 1 mbit (reports/loss-ledger-confirm-defect/FINDING.md: confirmed_total=0, 3/3 runs) because EAI carries the 65 B / 31 B·s⁻¹ return-bw prior (sender.rs:1395-1397, :3271). The spec-preauthorized fix (measured return_bw, §3.3-E FULL; engine spec 419-420, 988, 1071) has no code. Is a live loss signal in <20 s flows a v1 requirement (then WIRE = blocker), or is the loss-blind short-flow regime accepted for v1?

PreConverge ledger leakage: sender.rs:3004 calls loss.on_ack unconditionally, so packet-threshold hits in PreConverge (srtt None) are removed from detector.inflight, ledgered Suspected and counted in lost_units (loss.rs:658-662) while queue_losses/tombstones are skipped (sender.rs:3074). Spec §3.3-C(1) says no loss declaration at all. Tests pin diag_loss/tombstone=0 but not ledger internals. Does the owner consider a PreConverge-era Suspected→Confirmed event (fuzzy loss input) acceptable, and can a unit dropped from detector.inflight but still in sender.inflight be recovered only by §3.3-B copies?

Receiver RX_REORDER hold (engine spec §4:398 'bekle') vs code SoC (receiver.rs:9-11 reports all gaps; tolerance only sender-side §9.3). Spec §4:404 itself points to §9.3. Under 'spec wins', which text is authoritative — amend §4 or implement a receiver hold?

DSACK-like duplicate report (§9.3:695, §9.4:700-701) is unimplemented and superseded by per-transmission seq + tombstone late-ACK (spec 445-448). Should the spec sentence move to an appendix with MUST-NOT-IMPLEMENT (CLAUDE.md §6) — owner spec edit?

reordering_score EWMA (§6:541-544, NORMATİF; TDD §5.1:535) is not implemented; fuzzy jitter = rttvar/srtt only (sender.rs:3396-3399). Is the 'loss LOW ∧ jitter HIGH → arq reorder-tolerant' rule required to react to pure reordering (no RTT variance) in v1?

residual_loss (§5:460; AMENDMENT-2 §5.1:497-499 as §11 health input) has zero producers (on_unrecovered never called in product) and zero consumers. Wire it (define 'unrecovered': ARQ cap exceeded / deadline expired / tombstone expired) or formally demote to diag?

Bench kama-product default arm ≠ RuntimeConfig::default(): fec_loss_risk maps to FecLossRiskConfig::default() (OFF) unless --fec-risk, and --fec-risk selects experimental_v1 (FixedSrtt, 125/250, no G1) rather than bounded_v1 (kama_product.rs:187-192); structure_gate_level_permille maps to None vs product Some(250) (kama_product.rs:222). Which configuration is 'the product' for §4.4 claims? (FEC cluster, but it determines whether the ledger's Spurious share/reorder_pressure is exercised in bench.)

Stale documentation to correct: runtime.rs:842 '[FEC-RISK] ... default KAPALI' (actual default bounded_v1 enabled); fate_estimator.rs:27-29 and lib.rs:32-34 'observation-only / no product caller' (structure gate consumes snapshot at sender.rs:3670).

Telemetry gaps on the product path: diag_tombstone (hits/evictions/ambiguous/credited), diag_fate_corrections, ledger_evicted_total, and the effective packet-threshold k / recent_max_reorder are not in ClientStats/FateWindowDiag; only the stub `kama` bench arm prints tombstone diag. Should these be added before any loss/spurious claim is made from kama-product runs?
